title: Unexpected errors/retries during OmniPod DASH activation
symptom: During OmniPod DASH activation, the user experienced 3 errors requiring retries. The first error was about not seeing the Pod, and the second complained about connection and service not found. Activation continued successfully after retry on all errors.
evidence_quote: The phone never showed any problem activating DASH. This time however I got 3 errors during activation. Activation continued successfully after retry on all errors.
